Tara: Quick sync? PR #4983 touches timeout/429 guidance and the JS/py snippets. Linter flagged the new stream-resume snippet.
Omar: On it. Where's the failing lint output?
Tara: docs-bot posted it in the PR: "code-snippet-lint: invalid fenced language" and a broken link to /errors/429 -> returns 404 :grimacing:
Jess: I can jump in to fix the snippet languages and validate links. Which SDK version should examples target?
Kevin: Target unified-js v2.0.0 and py-sdk 1.5. We changed retry headers in v2.
Jess: OK will update the JS snippet to use the new retry header + backoff example.
Kevin: Also need a small note about streaming interruptions: recommend resume-with-offset pattern and show how to trim context to avoid 429s.
Tara: Example for resume pattern (js):
```js
const res = await client.stream({model: 'rwd-2-stream', prompt: '...'});
res.on('chunk', chunk => { /* append */ });
// on reconnect: use lastTokenIndex to request from offset
await client.generate({prompt, start_offset: lastTokenIndex});
```
Jess: I'll add that and update the link to /errors/stream-interrupt -> points to the new runbook.
docs-bot: PR check: snippet-lint OK after fix, link-check FAILED -> /errors/429 still 404
Omar: Where should /errors/429 live? We removed the old page during the error-ref consolidation.
Tara: Move the consolidated 429 guidance into /errors/ratelimits and add redirects. Docs-team, can someone add a short redirect rule in the CDN config? cc @kevin
Kevin: I'll open infra ticket for CDN redirect. Meanwhile add a temporary in-doc note: "Moved to /errors/ratelimits (link updated 4765432115)"
Jess: I'll push a small PR to update examples and add the note. Want a second pair of eyes before merging.
Omar: I'll review after you push. If link-check passes I'll merge and request deploy.
Tara: Thanks everyone :rocket:
